sections.title: Arithmetic sequences
facts: The average of an arithmetic sequence is its middle term.

sections.title: Geometric sequences & series
facts: Term $n$: $ar^{n - 1}$. Three terms in a row: $b^2 = ac$.
Forever, when $-1 < r < 1$: $a + ar + ar^2 + \cdots = \frac{a}{1 - r}$.

sections.title: Recursion
facts: Write out the first terms carefully; check whether the sequence starts at $a_0$ or $a_1$.
Stairs with steps of $1$ or $2$: $W(n) = W(n - 1) + W(n - 2)$, with $W(1) = 1$, $W(2) = 2$.

sections.title: Telescoping & clever sums
facts: Alternating sums: group the terms in pairs.

sections.title: Finding the pattern
facts: Cycle of length $k$: use $n \bmod k$, and remainder $0$ means the LAST item.
Constant second differences mean a quadratic pattern.
